name: Feature Request
description: Propose a new idea for CodeShield AI.
labels: [enhancement]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: idea
    attributes:
      label: Description of the Proposed Feature
      placeholder: What feature would you like to see?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: rationale
    attributes:
      label: Rationale / Benefit
      placeholder: Why is this feature needed?
    validations:
      required: true
